mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM cms_page p LEFT JOIN cms_page parent ON parent.id = p.parent_id
p.status = #{status}
AND
( p.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR p.slug ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.summary, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.content, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(p.author, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') )
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.sort_order, 0) ASC, p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT
FROM cms_page p LEFT JOIN cms_page parent ON parent.id = p.parent_id ORDER BY COALESCE(p.sort_order, 0) ASC, p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC

SELECT
FROM cms_page p LEFT JOIN cms_page parent ON parent.id = p.parent_id WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cms_page ( title, slug, summary, content, parent_id, sort_order, author, status, published_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{slug}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{sortOrder}, #{author}, #{status}, #{publishedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_page SET title = #{title}, slug = #{slug}, summary = #{summary}, content = #{content}, parent_id = #{parentId}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, author = #{author}, status = #{status}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
